shared_acquisition_methods.authenticated_cli_environment: AUTOLAB_TOKEN may be supplied by an authorized runner; never print or persist the token.
shared_acquisition_methods.content_rule: Authoritative bytes or an authenticated render/export are required. Adjacent event prose, search snippets, list position, and conversational memory are not source locks.

h7_boundary: The Human Steward identifies OM26-H7 only as an additional Erdős problem. That label is not an exact hill identity or statement and cannot release the lane.

release_gate.effect: Release that hill for Solve decomposition only; no mathematical truth, novelty, certification, or competition-acceptance effect.

prohibited: map hill slots by ordering without authoritative evidence
start hill-specific proof or search work before source lock
reuse H1 evaluator semantics for another hill by analogy
promote source acquisition to mathematical certification
claim_boundary: Preparation and execution-control record only. Null fields remain unknown.

authoritative_unresolved_source_pool.rule: Acquire by exact organizer hill ID. Do not infer H2-H7 correspondence from list order, names, event prose, or memory.
